verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS app builder, but the evidence shows Lovable runs as a hosted service ('nothing to install', 'Lovable hosts your app'). Exporting or deploying the generated app's code outside Lovable is a different capability: it covers the user's output, not self-hosting Lovable's core product. There is no evidence of an on-prem or self-hosted edition.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
